title: Many data storage devices and certain file formats no longer run on your computer after a couple of years. So what is the most effective way to secure data and store it for a long time? ETH Library’s Digital Curation Office to the rescue! For both, data management and long-term archiving. Our new animation provides an overview of the most important services.
